mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cs_message_inbox ( receipt_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, response_json LONGTEXT NULL, created_at BIGINT NOT NULL )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cs_message_inbox (receipt_key, payload_hash, status, created_at) VALUES (#{key}, #{hash}, 'PROCESSING', #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash, status, response_json, created_at FROM cs_message_inbox WHERE receipt_key = #{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE cs_message_inbox SET status = 'COMPLETED', response_json = #{response} WHERE receipt_key = #{key} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE cs_message_inbox SET status = 'UNKNOWN' WHERE receipt_key = #{key} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
